welcome.subject: Welcome to Sirius CRM!
welcome.title: Welcome to Sirius CRM!
welcome.intro: We're thrilled to have you and {organizationName} as part of the Sirius family!
welcome.body: You now have access to the most intuitive CRM on the market. Here are your next steps:
welcome.step1Body: Start by adding your opportunities to the visual pipeline
welcome.step2Body: Import or manually create your client contacts
welcome.step3Body: Collaborate with your entire sales team
welcome.tip: On the Free plan you get up to 10 deals. Upgrade to Pro for unlimited access!
welcome.helpText: If you have any questions, we're here to help.

dealCreated.subject: New deal created: {dealTitle}
dealCreated.title: New deal created!
dealCreated.intro: A new deal has been added to your pipeline:
dealCreated.step1: Schedule a follow-up with the client
dealCreated.step2: Add notes about the initial meeting

dealStageChanged.subject: Deal updated: {dealTitle}
dealStageChanged.title: Deal Updated!
dealStageChanged.intro: The deal {dealTitle} has advanced in the pipeline!
dealStageChanged.nextStep1: Schedule a follow-up meeting with the client
dealStageChanged.nextStep2: Update the deal notes with recent information
dealStageChanged.nextStep3: Set reminders for the next steps in the process
dealStageChanged.nextStep4: Check that all required documents are in order
dealStageChanged.closing: Keep working to close this deal!

followUp.subject: Follow-up reminder: {dealTitle}
followUp.title: Deal needs attention
followUp.intro: The deal {dealTitle} has been stalled for {daysSinceUpdate} days at stage {stageName}.
followUp.action2: Update the deal status in the pipeline
followUp.action3: Add a note about the current situation
followUp.action4Critical: Consider marking as lost if there is no response

paymentConfirmation.subject: Payment Confirmed — Sirius CRM Pro
paymentConfirmation.preview: Welcome to Sirius Pro! Payment confirmed
paymentConfirmation.title: Payment Confirmed!
paymentConfirmation.intro: We received your payment successfully and {organizationName} has been upgraded to the Pro Plan!
paymentConfirmation.tip: Explore multiple pipelines to organize different stages of your sales process.
paymentConfirmation.helpText: Need help? Contact our priority support at support@roilabs.com.br or via the in-dashboard chat.
paymentConfirmation.cancelText: Want to cancel? You can cancel at any time through the settings panel. No questions asked, no penalties.
paymentConfirmation.signature:
Thank you for choosing Sirius CRM!
Sirius Team

paymentFailure.subject: Payment failed — Action required
paymentFailure.warningFinalItem1: Your data is safe and remains in the system
paymentFailure.warningFinalItem3: You can reactivate your subscription at any time
paymentFailure.warningRetryText: Update your card to avoid losing the {planName} plan.
paymentFailure.introFinal: After {maxAttempts} unsuccessful billing attempts, the {planName} subscription for {organizationName} has been cancelled and the plan has been reverted to the Free plan.
paymentFailure.introRetry: We couldn't process the payment for your {planName} subscription for {organizationName}. This is attempt {attemptNumber} of {maxAttempts}.
paymentFailure.helpText: If you need help, please contact our support at support@roilabs.com.br.

upgradeNudge.subject: You're growing!
upgradeNudge.preview: You're close to your Free plan limit
upgradeNudge.title: You're growing!
upgradeNudge.intro: Congratulations! You already have {currentDeals} deals in your pipeline.
upgradeNudge.warningText: Only {remaining} more deals until you reach the limit
upgradeNudge.limitWarning: When you reach the limit of {maxDeals} deals, you won't be able to create new ones until you upgrade to the Pro plan.
upgradeNudge.footnote: Keep using the Free plan as long as you like. You can upgrade at any time!

weeklyNewsletter.subject: Weekly Summary — Sirius CRM
weeklyNewsletter.title: Weekly Summary
weeklyNewsletter.intro: Check out a summary of your team's activities for the week of {weekLabel}.
weeklyNewsletter.unsubscribeText: You receive this email because you have an active Sirius CRM account. To unsubscribe, go to Settings → Notifications in the dashboard.

invite.subject: You've been invited to Sirius CRM
invite.preview: {inviterName} invited you to {organizationName} on Sirius CRM
invite.title: You've been invited!
invite.intro: {inviterName} has invited you to join the {organizationName} team on Sirius CRM.
invite.body: Click the button below to create your account and start collaborating with the team:
invite.note: This link is valid for 7 days and can only be used once. If you weren't expecting this invitation, you can ignore this email.

whatsappMigration.subject: Important update: Official WhatsApp on Sirius CRM
whatsappMigration.preview: Important update: Official WhatsApp on Sirius CRM
whatsappMigration.intro: We have an important update about the WhatsApp integration for {organizationName} on Sirius CRM.
whatsappMigration.hookTitle: Never have your WhatsApp blocked again.
whatsappMigration.hookText: Meta is banning numbers that use unofficial integrations (Evolution API, Baileys, Whatsmeow and similar). That's why we migrated to the Official WhatsApp Business API (Meta Cloud API) — the only integration allowed by WhatsApp's Terms of Service.
whatsappMigration.goodNewsText: As a Sirius CRM customer before this change, you keep access to Official WhatsApp on your current plan — no upgrade needed.
whatsappMigration.change2: New integration: Official Meta API — zero risk of ban
whatsappMigration.change5: Full compliance with WhatsApp's Terms of Service
whatsappMigration.instructionText: To activate, go to Settings → Integrations → Official WhatsApp and follow the setup guide. Our team can also do the full setup for you for a one-time fee of $59.
whatsappMigration.footnote: Questions? Reply to this email or visit siriuscrm.com.br. We're here to help with the transition.

newMessageUser.subject: New reply on your ticket: {subject}
newMessageUser.title: New Reply on Your Ticket
newMessageUser.intro: The support team replied to ticket: {subject}
newMessageUser.footer: You are receiving this email because you opened a support ticket on Sirius CRM.

newTicketStaff.subject: New support ticket: {subject}
newTicketStaff.title: New Support Ticket
newTicketStaff.intro: {userName} from organization {organizationName} opened a new ticket.

ticketResolved.subject: Ticket resolved: {subject}
ticketResolved.title: Ticket Resolved
ticketResolved.intro: Your ticket "{subject}" has been marked as resolved by {staffName}.
ticketResolved.body: If the issue persists or you have more questions, you can reopen the ticket or create a new one directly in the support portal.
ticketResolved.footer: Thank you for using Sirius CRM. We're always here to help!
